overview_description.description:
Aptly uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to help property teams drive higher retention and renewals by recognizing effective communication patterns from millions of property conversations. Aptly analyzes email, SMS and phone calls so property teams and executives can understand what’s happening in every conversation. Aptly then correlates these conversation insights with property management data to route conversations to the most qualified team member and suggest or automate responses. Additionally, automates gathering feedback in a survey which gets factored into a resident and property happiness score.

Our team has 80 years of combined real estate experience, scaled and exited (IPO) a SaaS solution for the rentals industry and backed by Accel Ventures, Slack Fund and C-Level executives from Facebook, Salesforce.com and Twilio.

product.name: Aptly CRM and Workflow Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates CRM and workflow management for property teams, centralizing communication and property management data.

product.name: Shared Inbox for Property Teams
product.description: A shared inbox consolidating email, SMS, and phone communications for property teams to collaborate and manage customer interactions.

product.name: Lead Capture and Qualification Tools
product.description: Tools to capture leads from multiple sources and qualify them using chatbots and automated workflows.

product.name: Workflow Management and Automation
product.description: A system to track, manage, and automate property management workflows such as move-ins, lease renewals, and rehabs.

product.name: Customer Retention and Satisfaction Tools
product.description: Features to monitor resident satisfaction, personalize communication, and analyze customer happiness through surveys and data integration.

product.name: Mobile Application for Remote Work
product.description: A mobile app that enables property teams to manage communication and workflows from anywhere.
